blocks.text: In this program, we provide a supportive environment for 20 adults as they withdraw from substances. Detox is typically a 7 to 10 day stay, depending on what people have been using and how much. While people are with us, the staff help to set up next steps; treatment, employment, medical care etc. We also have 5 beds designated as transition beds for those people who need a clean place to stay while they are waiting for or coming back from Treatment. The average length of stay in our transition beds is 30 days but can be dependent on the wait lists.
